chunks.title: Designer’s CLO Journey: Creation and Decoration of 3D Flowers
chunks.content: ## Overview of CLO Interface and Initial Panel Preparation This section covers the setup and preparation of panels in CLO software for creating 3D flower decorations, focusing on internal lines, panel dimensions, and extension tools. The interface displays a girl group panel with three-dimensional decorative internal lines drawn at the top. The particle diameter is lowered initially to facilitate modifications. The group length is measured, and a panel of 230mm width and approximately 730mm length is drawn twice. Using the extension panel tool, the panel is extended at a fixed 15-degree angle by right-clicking to set distance or angle parameters. One half of the panel is extended and then symmetrically aligned with the other half. After selection, the panel is copied (Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V), arranged according to the model layout, and unlinked. The middle link in the frame is selected and merged into one version, creating a scattered style similar to the reference picture. Sewing lines are added to balance the side seams, and after flattening the simulation, minor corrections are made to the group panel.
